# miniz

This directory vendors the unmodified amalgamated `miniz.c`, `miniz.h`, and `LICENSE` files from miniz 3.1.2.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/richgel999/miniz>
- Release: <https://github.com/richgel999/miniz/releases/tag/3.1.2>
- Release archive SHA-256: `F0446D863F9C19926AD9483C523FDC42E42B8D4A6A431D27E09D49C79A140D9A`
- License: MIT; see [LICENSE](LICENSE)

The launcher uses miniz only for ZIP archive enumeration and extraction. Update the version, hashes, notices, tests, and packaged license together when upgrading this dependency.
